fields.description: As a customer I want to place an order so that I can buy items.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid SKU and quantity, POST /orders returns 201 with an order id
Given a quantity of zero, POST /orders returns 400

fields.description: As a customer I want to fetch an order by id.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an existing order id, GET /orders/{id} returns 200 with the order
Given an unknown order id, GET /orders/{id} returns 404
